abilities.effect: The trap deals 8d10+40 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 46 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Electrocution

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Electricity
traits.text: Effects with this trait deal electricity damage. A creature with this trait has a connection to magical electricity.

traits.name: Evocation
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the evocation school of magic, typically involving energy and elemental forces.

abilities.trigger: A creature touches the gate directly or with a tool

hazard.description: A warded metal gate electrocutes anyone who touches the gate without pressing the bypass button.
hazard.disable: DC 47 Thievery (legendary) to destroy the ward, *dispel magic* (8th level; counteract DC 47) to counteract the ward, or press the bypass button
hazard.name: Electrified Gate
hazard.reset: The trap resets automatically if triggered, after 1 minute if the bypass button is pressed, or after 15 minutes if disabled or counteracted.
hazard.stealth: DC 47 (master) or DC 50 (legendary) to notice the bypass button hidden in a skull's eye socket

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
